newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha edges higher as futures rise.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha edges higher as futures rise.

text.p: NWE naphtha was slightly firmer on Friday as futures markets gained in strength.

Dealers said June swaps were talked at around $183 a tonne cif NWE while the contango to July was slightly wider again and worth around $1 a tonne, after the spread narrowed slightly on Thursday because of prompt strength.
Physical cargo traders were unwilling to discuss fixed-price numbers but some felt that Dow quality material should be worth a dollar or two more than June swaps.
